tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List all site languages, content kinds and translation fallback policy.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List public root sections with localized names, summaries and source URLs. Restricted sections expose only a public teaser.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Browse published sections, articles, research digests, reader questions and blog posts. Filter by kind or root; use next_offset for pagination.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public sexpreparat.ru content in the selected language. All query words must match; results include localized source URLs. Up to six words are used.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read a published material by numeric id or slug, in any site language. Returns Markdown, source URL and per-field translation language. Restricted text is a teaser; unrevealed answers are hidden.

tools.name: get_question
tools.description: Read a published reader question and its editorial answer by id. Answers scheduled for a later day are hidden.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
